findings.passage: In each of her five sessions, Valoree has been a member of the Texas House Committee on Elections, working with both parties to keep our elections safe and secure.
findings.note: Campaign-site statement in her name (written in the third person) about her Elections Committee work. It names no specific ID or citizenship rule.

findings.passage: As a member serving on the Elections Committee and the Urban Affairs Committee, I am fighting to keep elections fair and secure and to keep the voices of voters represented in the process of approving or stopping low-income housing developments.
findings.note: Official House newsletter from her office, written in the first person. It speaks generally of keeping elections fair and secure; it names no specific ID or citizenship rule. The same newsletter has an issue survey asking whether the state should do more to combat election fraud.

findings.motion: House Elections Committee vote reporting SB 5 favorably without amendment
findings.note: A House Research Organization analysis of SB 5, titled as modifying voter ID requirements and providing a criminal penalty, lists her among the 5 ayes in the Elections Committee vote (2 nays). This is a committee vote, separate from the floor conference-committee vote already on file.

findings.motion: listed as a co-author of HB 329
findings.note: The official bill page lists her among the co-authors of HB 329 by Cain, relating to election integrity. Last action shown is referral to the Elections committee on 2021-02-25. The page does not give the date she was added.

findings.motion: listed as a co-author of HB 6
findings.note: The official bill page lists her among the co-authors of HB 6, relating to election integrity and security, including preventing fraud in elections and increasing criminal penalties. Last action shown is laid on the table subject to call on 2021-05-07. The page does not give the date she was added.

findings.motion: listed as a co-author of HB 5337
findings.note: The official bill page lists her among the co-authors of HB 5337 by Isaac, relating to requiring a person to submit proof of citizenship to register to vote and creating criminal offenses. Last action shown is committee report sent to Calendars on 2025-05-07. The page does not give the date she was added.
